videos.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
videos.description: The Princess Ball descends into chaos when Vexius and the Trix crash the party.

videos.title: The Next Step: Cheer
videos.description: The team try to get their full-out to time, but Angel struggles. Heath worries Jax is ashamed of their friendship, and Layla gets upset with Damian.

videos.title: Newsround
videos.description: Topical news magazine for children.

videos.title: Blue Peter: Secret Santa Showdown, Greg James and Festive Crafts
videos.description: Secret Santa Showdown, Greg James and Festive Crafts. Abby and Leo go head-to-head in a festive blacksmith challenge.

videos.title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
videos.description: Winter may be closing in, but Adam Frost has thrown on his warm coat and is sharing some practical jobs and seasonal inspiration to keep gardens thriving through the colder months.

videos.title: Life in a Cottage Garden with Carol Klein
videos.description: Series following a year in Carol Klein's garden at Glebe Cottage. In January and February, the frosts of a hard winter have not yet released their grip on the garden.

videos.title: Naturewatch
videos.description: Why do foxes' eyes shine in the dark? And how do sea anemones deliver their sting.

videos.title: Whisky Galore!
videos.description: Classic Ealing comedy about the mayhem that ensues when a whisky-laden ship runs aground off the coast of the Outer Hebrides during the Second World War.

videos.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
videos.description: Marcus expands his herb patch, giving a new perspective on ingredients, and has a close encounter with some bees.

videos.title: Homes Under the Hammer
videos.description: A beautiful building in Bath. Martin meets a couple who have bought a flat in a period, listed building, and luckily for them, they own the flat below too.

videos.title: Kelly's Heroes
videos.description: When a German officer carrying some gold bars falls into the hands of a US platoon, Kelly and his sergeant Big Joe gather a team of men to 'liberate' the remaining ingots.

videos.title: Final Score
videos.description: Jason Mohammad and guests bring you all the goals, latest news, analysis, reaction and interviews from the afternoon's biggest football matches.

videos.title: Snooker: UK Championship 2026
videos.description: Live coverage from day 1 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

videos.title: A Bridge Too Far
videos.description: The Allies have a daring plan to stop World War II by the end of 1944, called Operation Market Garden. Could it work? Or are they going a bridge too far.

videos.title: U2 at the BBC
videos.description: A selection of U2's most memorable BBC appearances, including performances of Fire, I Will Follow, Two Hearts Beat as One, Sunday Bloody Sunday and Where the Streets Have No Name.

videos.title: U2: Live on the BBC at Tate Modern
videos.description: Global titans U2 perform at the Tate Modern in London for a truly unique live collaboration of music and art.

videos.title: U2: Tracks of My Years
videos.description: Bono, The Edge, Adam Clayton and Larry Mullen Jr - join Vernon Kay to choose ten songs from their lives as they release their new album, Carnaval De Luz.

videos.title: U2 Play Belfast
videos.description: World-famous rock band U2 are captured in a 1981 performance at Queen's University, Belfast, performing tracks including I Will Follow and 11 O'Clock Tick Tock.

videos.title: Snooker: UK Championship Extra 2026
videos.description: Highlights from day 1 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

videos.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
videos.description: In the penultimate leg, the teams descend on the checkpoint in the dead of night.

videos.title: Bill's Included
videos.description: When Bill finds out the lodgers have given themselves nicknames but left him out, he embarks on an ill-advised quest to attract one of his own.

videos.title: This is BBC Two
videos.description: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

videos.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
videos.description: Horticulturist Christine Walkden explores gardens and countryside from a hot-air balloon. Christine takes to the skies above Yorkshire and visits Scampston Hall.

videos.title: Countryfile
videos.description: Charlotte Smith and Sean Fletcher are in the Ceiriog Valley in north Wales, meeting former clinical vet Claire Whittle, who took on an upland farm two years ago.

videos.title: BBC News
videos.description: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

videos.title: Landward
videos.description: Dougie visits a crannog on Loch Tay, and Shahbaz is in the Cowal Peninsula, where she meets a couple who are rewilding their dairy farm.

videos.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
videos.description: Matt Tebbutt presents a feast of food from Jamie Oliver, Alison Roman and Owen Morgan. Also, Rick Stein and the Hairy Bikers head out of the studio.

videos.title: White Christmas
videos.description: Christmas classic. Two army buddies travel to a Vermont ski resort for a well-earned rest, but end up putting on a show. With Bing Crosby, Danny Kaye and Rosemary Clooney.

videos.title: Snooker: UK Championship 2026
videos.description: Live coverage from day 2 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

videos.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
videos.description: In the penultimate leg, the teams descend on the checkpoint in the dead of night.

videos.title: Why Sinkholes Collapse
videos.description: Astonishing video of the 2025 Bangkok sinkhole, one of the largest to hit a major city, and an investigation into what caused it. Why are sinkholes in cities increasing.

videos.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
videos.description: Lucy has the keys to the Doge's Palace in Venice, where she has a close shave in a torture chamber and discovers a 24-carat gold staircase, hidden doors and secret messages.

videos.title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
videos.description: Paul and Bob fish the River Beaulieu and have their annual catch-up with Dr Anand Patel.

videos.title: A Course Called Ireland
videos.description: The adventure isn't over yet, as stormy golf brings an unexpected refuge. Bill turns the spotlight on Tom, and the pair reflect on how far they've come. Contains strong language.

videos.title: Scrum V
videos.description: Lauren Salter and guests reflect on Wales's performance in the Nations Championship.

videos.title: Highland Cops
videos.description: Police on Skye hunt a suspect after a violent attack on a barman, officers raid a suspected drugs base in Inverness, and a reported home invasion takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Beacons: Short Films from Wales - Brain Space
videos.description: When Rhi's inner child is threatened by the shadows of her own trauma, her fear turns to anger and she must fight back to regain control.

videos.title: Nature's Biggest Beasts
videos.description: Big beasts have always captured the imagination, but being large comes with sizeable challenges. These are the epic survival stories of the world's largest animals.

videos.title: Snooker: UK Championship Extra 2026
videos.description: Highlights from day 2 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

videos.title: Question Time
videos.description: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Clydebank. On the panel are Stephen Flynn, Melanie Ward, Russell Findlay, Malcolm Offord and Holly Bruce.

videos.title: Honey
videos.description: Martha strives to keep Kamilla onside. Friedrich makes a drastic move to catch Martha out. Contains some strong language and some upsetting scenes.

videos.title: This is BBC Two
videos.description: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

videos.title: Blue Planet III
videos.description: A journey into the last great frontier on earth: the deep. It was once considered empty, but now, thanks to new technology, we know life thrives there in astonishing abundance.

videos.title: Match of the Day
videos.description: On a big Sunday of Premier League action, Arsenal face Manchester City, and it's Everton v Liverpool in the Merseyside derby.

videos.title: BBC News
videos.description: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

videos.title: Politics Live
videos.description: The big political issues of the day.

videos.title: Snooker: UK Championship 2026
videos.description: Live coverage from day 3 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: This edition comes from Dover Castle in Kent. Experts James Lewis and Catherine Southon discover a silver inkwell and a classical bust.

videos.title: House of Games
videos.description: Matt Baker, Charley Marlowe, Rose Matafeo and Jack Rooke test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

videos.title: Strictly - It Takes Two
videos.description: Ellie Taylor kicks off the week by exclusively chatting to the latest couple to be eliminated, and Friday's all-star panel of Strictly alumni return to break down the weekend's action.

videos.title: Global Eye
videos.description: BBC Ukrainian Service reporter Anastasiya Gribanova sets out in search of answers, beginning a dangerous and deeply emotional journey to uncover the truth about how her family members died.

videos.title: Mastermind
videos.description: Clive Myrie hosts as four more contenders answer questions on specialist subjects, including the musical Cabaret, King John and the wrestler Bret Hart.

videos.title: Only Connect
videos.description: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far. It's the third appearance of both teams, and a place in the next round is at stake.

videos.title: University Challenge
videos.description: The round of 16 continues. Teams from Manchester and Warwick return to play for a second time, each hoping to earn themselves a quarter-final spot. Amol Rajan asks the questions.

videos.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
videos.description: Lucy has the keys to Versailles, where hidden doors reveal the life of Marie Antoinette. Deals with adult themes.

videos.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
videos.description: A high-speed car chase, involving Peelers Bert and Harry, comes to an unexpected end. Contains very strong language.

videos.title: Newsnight
videos.description: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Victoria Derbyshire.

videos.title: The Misadventures of Romesh Ranganathan
videos.description: In Madagascar, Rom hikes razor-sharp rocks, encounters alarming delicacies and comes face to face with the island's legendary dancing lemurs. Contains strong language.
